name: Laravel + MySQL (Compose)
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y unzip zlib1g-dev libzip-dev libpng-dev libjpeg-dev libfreetype6-dev && docker-php-ext-configure gd --with-freetype --with-jpeg && docker-php-ext-install -j$(nproc) gd zip calendar && echo 'XDEBUG_MODE=off' | sudo tee -a /etc/environment && php -m | grep -E 'gd|zip|calendar'
